MinFill.description:
Minimum share of capacity a vehicle must carry when it departs.

A number is the share of the primary dimension. A mapping gives a share per
dimension, for example ``{desi: 0.4, kg: 0.5}``; a vehicle then counts as
filled when it reaches the share of any one of them, so a vehicle that is
heavy but not bulky is not called empty. Dimensions that are left out, or
given as 0, are not looked at.

spot.description: Share for spot vehicles: a number, or one per dimension.
spot.title: Spot

owned.description: Share for owned vehicles: a number, or one per dimension.
owned.title: Owned

MinFill.title: MinFill

ObjectiveSpec.description:
The objective to minimize, built from the costs and rules of the document.

The objective is ``cost`` times the total cost (dispatch costs, the fixed
cost of mandatory owned vehicles and lateness), plus the optional extra
terms, plus a weight per unit of violation of every built-in rule. Every
rule a plan can break needs a weight: name it under ``penalties`` (the names
are those of :data:`pirilib.constraints.CATALOG`), or give ``other`` for
every rule that is not named. A weight of 0 lets a plan break the rule for
free, so it has to be written down.

A rule written as ``hard`` instead of a weight must hold. The solvers treat it
as a limit: it gets :attr:`hard_weight`, far above the costs, so no saving is
worth breaking it. A plan that breaks a hard rule is not feasible. When the
hard rules cannot all hold, the solvers still return the plan that breaks
them least, and the evaluation says which ones are broken.

cost.description: Weight of the total cost: dispatches (fixed, per km and per hour), the fixed cost of mandatory owned vehicles and lateness.
cost.title: Cost

unused_capacity.description: Weight per primary unit of capacity left empty on departure.
unused_capacity.title: Unused Capacity

penalties.description: Weight per unit of violation, by rule name, or 'hard' for a rule that must hold; 'other' applies to every rule not named. Without 'other', every rule must be named.
penalties.title: Penalties

ObjectiveSpec.title: ObjectiveSpec

Service.description:
Due times, the cost of lateness and how long demand may wait.

Unloading after the due time also breaks the ``lateness`` rule, which the
objective weighs like every other rule: 0 leaves lateness a cost only, and
``hard`` makes the due times limits.

due_hours.description: Due time of demand without one, in hours after it is ready; null: none.

penalty.description: Cost per primary unit for every started hour of lateness.

max_deferral_days.description: Days after its date a demand may still leave.

SpotOffer.description:
On-demand vehicles of one type, hired per dispatch.

Several offers may have the same vehicle type: price tiers, such as two
vehicles a day at the contract price and further ones at the market price,
or the offers of different carriers. Each offer has its own cost and its
own daily limit.

name.title: Name

available.description: Vehicles per day; null means unlimited.
available.title: Available

stopovers.description: A vehicle may serve several destinations on one route; false: every vehicle of the offer goes to one destination.
stopovers.title: Stopovers

max_stops.description: Destinations per vehicle; null means no limit.
